items.headline: Albemarle (ALB) Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
items.snippet: Management of Albemarle Corporation (NYSE:ALB) reported growth in net sales and profitability for the second quarter, driven by pricing strength in the lithium and bromine markets. Global lithium consumption was up 45% year-over-year through May, tracking above forecasted range.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $225 from $245 at Truist
items.snippet: Truist analyst Peter Osterland lowered the firm's price target on Albemarle to $225 from $245 and keeps a Buy rating on the shares. Albemarle continues to execute on cost efficiencies and capital discipline, supporting strong free cash flow potential.
